reviews.x: Absolutely perfect! Looks exactly like the picture and is very soft! They apply my makeup very well!
They look great just like the picture. The brush part is soft and they seem sturdy and well put together. So far no issues with shedding or anything.

reviews.t: Great quality, Super soft, works with cream, liquid, and powder!
reviews.x: These makeup brushes area really wonderful, especially for the price. I wasn't expecting much, to be honest, but these are MUCH nicer quality brushes than I was expecting. This set comes with pretty much everything you need, especially if you're just starting off with makeup. I definitely recommend! I got he purple ones, and they are SOOO pretty. SUPER soft, and work just lovely!

Great make up brushes especially for the money. You receive 10 pieces very good quality brushes. Also the colors are very bright and nice. Very happy with my purchase. I will buy more for Christmas gifts!
Gorgeous and really good quality picture is from when I received them used them already and still the same quality after drying really recommend this brushes
Came in quickly and are a nice quality for the price!

These brushes are not good for your face. The hairs in the brushes will scrape your skin. I was using a brush to set my under eye and the skin is very sensitive under there and it felt like little tiny needles stabbing my skin. Throwing these brushes away!!!
I love these brushes, they are soft and so pretty. I waited until after washing them to post my review just so I could see if they would shed or fall apart... they didn’t!!

reviews.t: Super soft and hold up great!!
reviews.x: Love it got it for a gift for my boss and she loves them !! Super soft and hold up great!!

reviews.t: Beautiful, work great, good variety, great price point
reviews.x: I needed a new “back up” set of brushes and I saw a friend using these as a giveaway in a contest. I just thought they were pretty but once I looked them up I was pleasantly surprised with the price point. One receiving, they didn’t have an odor (as some “off brand” online brushes will) and were incredibly soft. They work like a charm for what I use them for and are beautiful in person too.

reviews.t: Love it! Well worth it! Gorgeous!
reviews.x: I bought this for a gift and she absolutely loved it! She actually went and got a decorated cup to keep them out on counter. Color was just as beautiful if not more in person. Quality was well worth money. Each brush even had a net around it to keep them from losing there form! Will definately but again. Was the perfect touch to the rest of the gift :)

I've been collecting makeup brushes since the early days of Bare Minerals (dating myself) - and these are fantastic - they're long and solid, and the bristles are super soft. I have sensitive skin, and many brushes over the years have left me with a slight burning or itching sensation after applying makeup - not these. They're fantastic!

Really surprised at how nice these are. The brushes are soft but not too soft, no bristles falling out or 'shedding'. They pick up setting powder really well with no clumping, handles are a good size for handling and have a good weight to them and are aesthetically very sleek and classy looking. Shipping was fast. Very pleased with them.

I bought these as a gift for one of my best friends for Christmas. She absolutely adores them. They look beautiful in person, are soft, and make a great quality gift for the price. The packaging could have been better but I will take quality in the product over visually stimulating packaging any day.

with makeup brushes, most of the time you get what you pay for..these are soft and the handle design is very cute and unique. however, i’m not a fan of how light and cheap the handles feel. Great for the price point definitely. but think for a few more dollars BH would be worth it.

reviews.t: Money well spent! Love this item
reviews.x: Came right away. Love love loooove the brushes!!! I cleaned them they did not flake or fall apart smooth on my skin and very good with my Morphe pallet. The ombré purple was the plus I love the look the feel. My sister wants a set now so I will be ordering as a gift. :)

Just recieved these beautiful brushes yesterday, so I've not done alot with them so far. Obviously they're BEAUTIFUL! 💜😊😍🖤 They seem like great quality, strong handles & soft brissels. For the price & quality can't beat it. You must get a set for yourself. 😘Kristen

Got the purple ones and I really like how they lool and how soft they feel. I pretty happy with how well they work..I did notice a little bit of shedding with the bigger brushes when using them but nothing too crazy. I would buy them again in the future.

I've really liked this set for makeup application. It's made my foundation look pretty good and I normally dont like brush application on my face.  Some LIGHT shedding, but I've now washed the brushes 4 times and that is no longer happening. Really soft.

The brushes are great for the price. Look just like they do in the picture. Very pretty and seem sturdy and no shedding. I love them I would highly recommend these to anyone looking for brushes. Came nicely packaged in a box individually wrapped.

I love the color and texture. The brushes work well. Just keep in mind to be extra heavy handed when applying blush to ensure the color is applied properly and the pigment is visible. This brush set also adds a glamorous look to my vanity set.

reviews.t: Large brushes are great, small ones okay
reviews.x: The large brushes are very soft and work very nice. Some of the smaller ones lack some softness and seem to fray a bit. They are still usable and the value is still great, just not sure how long they will hold up over time.
Beautiful brushes! They aren't going to be for hard core professionals. But they are excellent for an average person. Or a starter set. Great for the price! Synthetic bristles. Do not seem to shed.
I like how the brushes came individually wrapped in a cellophane and the bigger brushes are wrapped in a tight netting to protect the bristles. The bristles are very soft and blend easily.
I bought these as a gift for my 18 yo. neice. She seems to like them. I know they are soft because she kept going around the house, brushing them across her face.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the brushes as soft and good quality, often noting they exceed expectations for the price.
Many customers say the brushes look beautiful and match the product pictures, making them good gifts.
Several reviewers report no shedding or bristle fallout, even after washing.
A few reviewers mention the handles feel light or cheap, and one reports the bristles scraping sensitive skin.
